title.narrative: Indonesia Energy: New Zealand-Maluku Access to Renewable Energy Support 2.0

description.narrative: This Activity will build on our previous RE support in Eastern Indonesia ‘New Zealand Maluku Access to Renewable Energy Support’ (NZMATES 1.0). The new Activity (NZMATES 2.0) will provide technical assistance and capacity building to accelerate renewably generated electricity development in Maluku, within Eastern Indonesia, addressing local barriers to RE development and building sustainable local capacity.
